title: You Have Been Chosen
description: The four young adventures have received the blessing of the Wind Crystal. Go forth and meet their destiny!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Painkiller
description: The Warriors of Light have aided an old man with a timely tincture and have been rewarded for their kindness.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Monster-in-a-Box!
description: Our heroes have wrested the Wight Slayer from a beast lurking within a treasure box!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: We Fear Change
description: Four onion kids have braved the Cave of the Seal and journeyed to its end without using any of the vocational blessings given by the Wind Crystal.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Filling in the Blanks
description: Through deft bladework and and mystical might the Warriors of Light have lifted the Jinn's curse!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: The Best Medicine
description: Cid's granny is feeling much better after our heroes cured what ailed her.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Diminishing Returns
description: After their leap of faith, the Warriors of Light are gifted the spell of miniaturization.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: The Doctor's Doctor
description: A hidden road is revealed to our heroes thanks to their penchant for medicating miniature menders.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Why Are You Even Here?!
description: Four foolish heroes have ventured into the Nepto Shrine and escaped with its treasure, led the entire time by a brave warrior who eschews magic.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Pest Control
description: The Warriors of Light have calmed Nepto's madness!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Breadwinner
description: For circling the world on a chocobo, our heroes have been given the gift of baked goods.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Meet the Gurgans
description: The Warriors of Light have received a toadally useful gift from a mysterious race of prophets.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Jump in the Fire
description: Four heroes contemplate mortality after saving their world from plummeting to its doom.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Protégé of Perseus
description: The malicious Medusa has been slain by the Warriors of Light, with a single Fighter (aka Warrior) doing all of the damage!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: The Grass Is Greener Here
description: Standing amidst bleating sheep, the Warriors of Light take in their first sight of the country town of Gisahl.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: You're Gonna Carry That Weight
description: Behold! A beast that stores your baubles in its belly!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Chill Out
description: And lo, the Warriors of Light froze the cunning Guzco, finishing him off with ice-elemental black magic!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Stone-Cold Robbed
description: Beaming with joy, the four heroes successfully return the dwarfs' horn... or do they?
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Pyro Punching Power
description: The scorching fires of the Salamander have been extinguished by our heroes without any mages in the party!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: I Dub Thee Sir Hotpants
description: The power of the Fire Crystal has ignited new potential within the Warriors of Light!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Illiterate Warriors
description: Who needs books? The Warriors of Light have navigated the flying elder tree and defeated the nefarious Hyne without taking on the role of a scholar.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: The Root of the Problem
description: The eldest tree has returned to the living forest. The forest spirits are content.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Is This Safe to Drink...?
description: A reclusive chemist has generously donated two terrific tinctures to the party in exchange for saving the kingdom.
author: TheMysticalOne

description: The Warriors of Light have ventured out to the surface world to see what trouble awaits them beyond the lands of their birth.
author: TheMysticalOne

description: The water cave's barrier has been unsealed!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Seafood Soup
description: The Warriors of Light, utilizing all four vocations granted by the Fire Crystal, have defeated the Kraken!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Wave of Success
description: Awash with the power of the Water Crystal, the Warriors of Light are showered with new power as the world emerges...
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Respect Your Elders
description: Help from a strange source has allowed the Warriors of Light to acquire floating shoes.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: The Honest Approach
description: Traversing the entirety of Goldor's Mansion with nary a thief among them, the Warriors of Light have successfully unchained their impounded aircraft.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Robin Hood and His Merry Men
description: A motley band of hunters, bards, and thieves has knocked Goldor down!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: The Midas Touch
description: At last, the Enterprise's chains are broken!
author: TheMysticalOne

title: Welcome to Summoning 101
description: The four heroes have located the summoners' town.
author: TheMysticalOne

title: The Musical Kingdom
description: Seeking songs of wisdom, the four heroes set foot in the town of bards.
author: TheMysticalOne

description: The four heroes, understanding foreshadowing, have emptied the Dragon Tower of its holdings.
author: TheMysticalOne

description: Our heroes have laid waste to the blusterous Garuda without the aid of any dragoons!
author: TheMysticalOne

description: With the construction of the Nautilus, the Warriors of Light look ahead to a future of speedy travel.
author: TheMysticalOne

description: Our heroes encounter a brand new race of creatures: Moogles!
author: TheMysticalOne

description: Our intrepid heroes have gained the ability to travel beneath the waves and explore the shadowed depths of the ocean.
author: TheMysticalOne

description: Thanks to their undersea mobility, the Warriors of Light discovered a village of magic to lighten the weight of their purses.
author: TheMysticalOne

description: The beautiful music of Noah's Lute is now in the hands of the Warriors of Light.
author: TheMysticalOne

author: TheMysticalOne

description: The Warriors of Light have acquired their very own flying fortress.
author: TheMysticalOne

description: And so, the Warriors of Light plundered the town of Falgabaad, leaving no treasures behind.
author: TheMysticalOne

description: The Warriors of Light, utilizing four different vocations granted by the Water Crystal, have defeated Hekaton!

author: TheMysticalOne

description: The Warriors of Light have claimed the Sylx and Eureka keys.

description: Our heroes have proven themselves worthy of summoning Odin.
